verdict.rationale: Syncing a generated app to the user's own GitHub repository is a fair question for an AI app builder like Figma Make, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a GitHub connection, push/pull, or two-way sync. The in-app code editing, change review and version history (docs-7, docs-8, docs-9) are adjacent features, not repository sync. Community posts describe users reverse-engineering the .make format just to extract code, which further suggests no first-party repo export exists.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync my project to my own GitHub repository and keep changes flowing both ways
